# Factorize

Hosted workflow: connect your agent → create a job → run it → inspect the result → automate it.

Application: https://app.factorize.sh
MCP (Streamable HTTP + OAuth): https://app.factorize.sh/mcp

Browser: email/password signup, verification, execution/provider connections and consent.
MCP: discover targets, manage jobs, invoke with retained idempotency keys, inspect state/context/diagnostics.
Current MCP does not return execution output; inspect browser traces or REST trace pages. REST is not full MCP parity.

## Get started

- [Factorize with your agent](https://docs.factorize.sh/): Connect your agent, create a job, run it, inspect the result, and automate it.
- [Connect your agent](https://docs.factorize.sh/mcp/overview): Authorize Codex or Claude Code for hosted Factorize.
- [Your first job](https://docs.factorize.sh/quickstart): Run a hosted repository review through MCP.

## Work with your agent

- [Create and edit jobs](https://docs.factorize.sh/work/jobs): Discover a target and replace configuration safely.
- [Write job prompts](https://docs.factorize.sh/work/prompts): Use stable trigger context and explicit execution instructions.
- [Inspect results](https://docs.factorize.sh/work/results): Read run state, output, prompt, and trigger context.
- [Stop and retry runs](https://docs.factorize.sh/work/stop-retry): Avoid duplicate work and understand current stop behavior.

## Automate jobs

- [Schedule a repository review](https://docs.factorize.sh/recipes/scheduled-review): Turn a successful manual review into daily automation.
- [Run a job from Linear](https://docs.factorize.sh/recipes/linear-job): Connect a workspace, select a project and match issues.
- [Automate from GitHub](https://docs.factorize.sh/integrations/github): Select an installation, repository, and event.
- [Automate from ClickUp](https://docs.factorize.sh/integrations/clickup): Connect a workspace and select matching tasks.
- [Chain jobs](https://docs.factorize.sh/recipes/chaining): Start a follow-up after another job finishes or is edited.
- [Connect your accounts](https://docs.factorize.sh/integrations/oauth): Browser setup, resource access, and delivery verification.
- [Trigger configuration](https://docs.factorize.sh/integrations/triggers): Configure schedules, provider webhooks, and lifecycle triggers.

## Troubleshooting

- [Connection problems](https://docs.factorize.sh/troubleshooting/connection): Recover authorization, scopes, and execution targets.
- [Jobs not firing](https://docs.factorize.sh/troubleshooting/events): Verify automation from provider event to accepted run.
- [Failed or stuck runs](https://docs.factorize.sh/troubleshooting/runs): Investigate evidence, fix the cause, and verify recovery.

## Reference

- [MCP tool reference](https://docs.factorize.sh/mcp/tools): Complete hosted MCP inventory, inputs, results, and common errors.
- [Jobs, triggers, runs, and targets](https://docs.factorize.sh/concepts): Understand the workflow before configuring automation.
- [REST API reference](https://docs.factorize.sh/api/reference): How to use the generated API reference.
- [Authentication and scopes](https://docs.factorize.sh/api/authentication): OAuth 2.1, device authorization, and access-token rules.
- [OAuth discovery](https://docs.factorize.sh/api/discovery): Endpoints and metadata for OAuth-aware clients.
- [OpenAPI definition](https://docs.factorize.sh/api/openapi): Download the verified Factorize REST contract.
- [REST operations](https://docs.factorize.sh/openapi.yaml): Complete generated REST schemas and operations

## Self-hosting

- [Optional self-hosting](https://docs.factorize.sh/self-hosting/deployment): Deploy your own Factorize instance.
- [Operator configuration](https://docs.factorize.sh/self-hosting/configuration): Email, OAuth applications, webhooks, and Worker secrets.
- [Operations and advanced trace recovery](https://docs.factorize.sh/self-hosting/operations): Operator checks, retained artifacts, and rollout evidence.
